answer: In the orchard, sable nodes face quadratic slashing commitments and super-linear capital expenditure scaling: a Sybil cluster paying c per identity incurs attack capital c n^2 while extractable value grows only as n, so marginal expenditure d(c n^2)/dn = 2cn dominates incremental yield at every n, and the saffron security threshold is met when locked collateral exceeds maximum extractable value by a factor of two.
